data.text: Criterion 5 is met with one refinement, DEC-49: the flag needs the close to come a day or more after the revision. The literal rule flagged 2 of the 3 task-linked documents in this journal (DOC-1/KAD-37, DOC-65/KAD-60), both revised under a minute before the close — false alarms. Now 0 here; there is no true positive in this journal to check against (3 of 65 documents are linked to tasks at all), so the signal is untested on real drift. prime 100-110 ms after the change. Full suite 1292 green; two perf.test.ts cold-start tests failed at load average 7.3 and pass alone (14/14).
